brief:
A man sustained serious injuries after being shot by settlers and Israeli occupation forces in the Rameen plain near Tulkarem, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incident occurred in an area that has seen repeated clashes between Palestinian residents and Israeli military and settler operations.

Details of the circumstances surrounding the shooting were not immediately available. The condition and identity of the wounded man have not been disclosed.
title: Settlers and Israeli troops shoot man in Ramallah plain near Tulkarem
